text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, they gave me so many free extras♪
Now all that's left is the meat and...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my? Isn't that—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Carrots, onions, potatoes...
Because they're standard ingredients, you'd want to add them,
but I must start by removing these first.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Beets, romanesco, Kyoto vegetables... No.
That would just be tossing in rare ingredients.
I have to think properly and find the optimal solution—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Messiah-chan.
If you're looking for something, would you like a hand?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Creek-senpai...!
I apologize, showing you such an embarrassing side of me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, today is a bargain sale day after all,
it's only natural to get a little distracted~.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, actually... I'm going to be treating
my friends to curry soon.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So, since it's such a rare opportunity,
I wanted to make a special curry that would delight everyone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that sounds lovely!
I would love to try your curry too, Messiah-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However... while searching for ingredients, I began to wonder.
What really makes a curry 'special'...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No matter how rare the ingredients or how particular I am about expensive spices,
can that truly be called 'special'?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Once I started thinking about that, I lost track of what I should do...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I see~. In that case, Messiah-chan.
Would you like to make some curry with me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll help you search for your 'special' touch, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're doing wonderfully, Messiah-chan~!
Both the little potatoes and the carrots are cut into just the right size.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now let's saute them in order just as the box says,
and let them simmer gently on low heat.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, Creek-senpai?
I hope it isn't rude of me to ask, but the curry you're making right now... is it by any chance...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪
It's just your ordinary home-cooked curry~.
I'm so glad I could get both the ingredients and the roux on sale today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The recipe is just what's written on the back of the box.
Even so, I'm sure you'll be surprised when you taste it.
So—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Here. Messiah-chan, say aaahn♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I-It's delicious...! Even though we didn't do anything 'special',
how is this possible...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you see? That's because a whole lot of 'special' secret ingredients
went into it~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: 'Special' secret ingredients...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Messiah-chan's kind feelings of wanting her friends
to eat delicious curry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And my feelings of wanting to pamper and praise such a good girl like Messiah-chan lots and lots.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Rare ingredients and fancy spices are ve~ry wonderful.
But the ultimate deciding factor of flavor is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The cook's heartfelt feelings...
Is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ Very well done, you get a big gold star~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even with ordinary ingredients, even if it gets a little burnt.
As long as you pour your heart into making it for the other person,
that alone makes it 'special'...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because any curry you make, Messiah-chan, will definitely be the 'right answer'
and a 'special' curry~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
All 'the right answer', and 'special'...
You are right...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Creek-senpai.
It seems I was far too bound by the word 'special'.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Next time I will try making it all by myself, so would it be alright if I asked you to taste test it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I will be sure to add plenty of that secret ingredient.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~! I'm really looking forward to seeing
how it turns out~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then let's think up Messiah-chan's recipe together once more~.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, regarding that, there's actually a vegetable I'd like to try.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Don't you think substituting sweet potatoes for regular potatoes would be quite innovative?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, what a lovely idea~.
In that case, let's start by thinking about ingredients that pair well with sweet potatoes, okay♪
